bind_address.description: IP address to bind the MariaDB server to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port on which MariaDB listens.

datadir.description: Directory where MariaDB stores database files.

socket.description: Unix socket file path for local client connections.

charset.description: Default character set for the server and new databases.

max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of one packet or internal buffer.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

general_log_file.description: Path to the general query log file.

time_zone.description: System time zone for the server.

default_storage_engine.description: Default storage engine for new tables.

log_error.description: Path to the error log file.

slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file.

long_query_time.description: Query execution time in seconds above which the query is logged as slow.

extra_options.description: List of additional key-value pairs for custom MariaDB configuration directives. Each item is a map with 'key' and 'value'. Items: {"key": {"type": "string", "default": "", "description": "Configuration directive name."}, "value": {"type": "string", "default": "", "description": "Configuration directive value."}}
